question: Will Anthropic release a new Claude Fable model before October 12, 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves YES if Anthropic officially releases a new Claude Fable model (newer than Fable 5.1) before October 12, 2026.

The model must be available to general users through an official channel (Claude apps, API, or cloud partners). Releases limited to selected partners or testers do not count. 

Any version number counts (5.2, 5.5, 6, etc.). Rumors, leaks, and hidden-routing reports do not count.
research:
# Research brief: will Anthropic release a Claude Fable model newer than 5.1 before October 12, 2026?

This brief uses only information published on or before 2026-10-08. A lot of what my searches returned was dated after that, so I left it out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question gives no URL. The best primary sources are Anthropic's newsroom and the Claude Platform model documentation.
- 2026-09-01: The Anthropic docs list Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`) as released September 1, 2026. It is on the Claude API, Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry, and the docs describe it as "the current Fable model." [docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/overview)
- 2026-09-15: The Anthropic newsroom index dates the item "Introducing Claude Mythos and Fable 5.1" to September 15. This doesn't match the docs and the launch coverage, which both say September 1. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news), [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/01/anthropic-claude-fable-5-1/)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-10-08 I found no official Anthropic announcement of a Fable 5.2, 5.5 or 6. Fable 5.1 is the latest official Fable model, and the question is not settled.
- 2026-10-07: Anthropic's latest model launch is Claude Haiku 5.5, which is not a Fable model. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- 2026-10-08: The newsroom items that day were the Cyber Mission, a Usage Policy update and a $150M Genesis Mission commitment. None was a model launch. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-07: Blog posts cite a Polymarket screenshot taken that day of a "Next Fable Model (5.2+) released by...?" market (details in section 5). [orcarouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/nl/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- 2026-10-06: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program. Secondary sources say Mythos 5.1 went out to approved users. Mythos is the restricted sibling of Fable and doesn't count for this question. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- Around 2026-10-01 to 10-06: Leakers started calling the rumored model "Fable 5.5" instead of 5.2, to match the 5.5 numbering of Opus, Sonnet and Haiku. A date of "Tuesday, October 6" circulated, and nothing was announced that day. This comes from secondary summaries; I couldn't load the primary pages. [fable5.app](https://fable5.app/fable-5-2/), [geotoolbox](https://geotoolbox.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-5)
- 2026-09-28: Claude Sonnet 5.5 released. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)
- 2026-09-22: Claude Opus 5.5 released. Anthropic's docs now say most workloads should start on Opus 5.5 and use Fable 5.1 for the hardest long-horizon work. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news), [docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-1/overview)
- 2026-09-21: TestingCatalog reported that Anthropic was testing "Fable 5.2" and Opus 5.5 ahead of release. Opus 5.5 shipped the next day; the Fable model did not. [TestingCatalog](https://www.testingcatalog.com/anthropic-tests-fable-5-2-and-opus-5-5-ahead-of-the-release/)
- Around 2026-09-18: Leakers said some Fable 5.1 requests were being routed to a newer backend they called "Fable 5.2". Reports like this don't count under the resolution criteria. [search summary](https://fable5.app/fable-5-2/)

## 4. Base rates
- Fable release history: Fable 5 came out 2026-06-09 and Fable 5.1 on 2026-09-01, about 12 weeks apart. [docs Fable 5](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5/overview)
- Context: one market listing says Anthropic suspended access to Fable 5 on 2026-06-12 after a US government directive. I could not verify this. [orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/will-claude-fable-5-be-restored-for-us-customers-by-august-31-668-138)
- On October 12, Fable 5.1 will be about 6 weeks old, roughly half the previous gap between Fable releases.
- Anthropic shipped three non-Fable models in 16 days (September 22 to October 7), so it is releasing models quickly right now. The question window from October 8 to 11 is only about 4 days.
- Earlier leak-based dates for a new Fable (the September 21 tests and the October 6 rumor) both passed without a release.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-07: According to blog posts citing a screenshot, Polymarket's "Next Fable Model (5.2+) released by...?" had its biggest volume (about $59.7K) in the October 31 contract, priced around 91¢. The rules exclude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1. I could not load the Polymarket page or see prices for any contract before October 12, so treat these numbers as unverified. [orcarouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/nl/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market specifically about Fable.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (October 8 to 11)
- I found no scheduled Anthropic event, keynote or developer conference in the window.
- October 10 and 11 fall on a Saturday and Sunday. Anthropic's recent launches have come on weekdays (Monday September 22, Wednesday October 7), though September 28 was a Sunday by the newsroom's date.
- Signals to watch: a new model page on platform.claude.com, the Anthropic newsroom, and what's-new posts from AWS, Google Cloud or Azure. Under the criteria, catalog sightings or partner-only access do not count without a public general release.
